title: Epistemic Infrastructures of Science in AI Era Should Rebalance Costs of Generation and Verification
abstract: arXiv:2605.10425v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI systems can now cheaply generate plausible scientific artifacts such as papers, reviews, and surveys. This creates a risk of \emph{epistemic pollution} in our scientific systems, where unreliable but plausible-looking artifacts can accumulate faster than the system can filter them out. The problem is structural: the epistemic infrastructure of science was calibrated to a world where producing a plausible artifact required substantial expertise, labor, and time, so generation cost itself served as a rough filter; AI weakens that filter without comparably lowering verification cost. This position paper argues that \textbf{AI-era science should rebalance the costs of generating and verifying scientific artifacts by redesigning epistemic infrastructure at the level of the artifact}. translated_title: AI时代的科学认知基础设施应重新平衡生成与验证的成本
translated_abstract: AI系统如今能够以低廉的成本生成看似合理的科学产物，例如论文、评审意见和综述。这给我们的科学体系带来了“认知污染”的风险：不可靠但看似合理的产物，其累积速度可能超过系统的过滤能力。这一问题是结构性的：科学的认知基础设施原本是针对一个“产出看似合理的产物需要大量专业知识、劳动和时间”的世界进行校准的，因此生成成本本身起到了粗略过滤器的作用；而AI削弱了这一过滤器，却没有相应地降低验证成本。本立场论文主张：AI时代的科学应当通过在产物层面重新设计认知基础设施，来重新平衡生成与验证科学产物的成本。当前以论文为中心的体系使验证成本高昂：论文将长上下文的科学逻辑压缩为文字，迫使审稿人和人类……
tldr: AI使生成看似合理的科学产物变得廉价，导致“认知污染”风险，本文主张在产物层面重新设计科学的认知基础设施，以重新平衡生成与验证的成本。
en_tdlr: AI makes generating plausible scientific artifacts cheap, risking epistemic pollution; this position paper argues for rebalancing generation and verification costs by redesigning artifact-level epistemic infrastructures of science.
